Description: This project involves the complete removal of the existing tile shingle roof on a 1650 square foot home in Berkeley, California, followed by inspection and repair of the roof decking as needed. A high-quality synthetic underlayment and new metal flashing will be installed to ensure moisture protection. The new standing seam metal roof panels will be factory-finished and installed with concealed fasteners and mechanically locked seams for durability and weather resistance. Ridge caps and ventilation will be added to promote airflow, and gutters and roof accessories will be inspected and replaced if necessary. The site will be thoroughly cleaned of debris, and a final inspection will be conducted with the homeowner. All work will comply with local permits and safety standards, with an estimated project duration of 5 to 7 days.
